•
Product-Strategic Thinking: Track record of driving product direction, not just executing on briefs. You've influenced what to build with research, framed problems for leadership, and made business-impact calls — ideally in environments where you operated without a dedicated PM.

Deep Engineering Collaboration: Demonstrable history of shipping work in tight partnership with engineers — including backend. Pairing on implementation, working in design tokens, understanding the systems your designs land in, building consensus rather than shipping around resistance.

Design Systems Experience: Background building or meaningfully contributing to a design system in a production product. You think in components, tokens, and patterns, not one-off screens.

Mission

As a Senior UI Artist , you will play a key role in shaping the visual quality and usability of a new mobile RPG experience. You’ll be responsible for creating and implementing polished, production-ready UI that feels intuitive, premium, and visually engaging for players. Your main responsibilities will include:

• Create clean, high-quality UI assets with strong readability, hierarchy, composition, and visual clarity

• Work directly inside Unity to integrate assets into scenes and prefabs in collaboration with developers

• Contribute to the ongoing visual overhaul of the game by improving existing flows and elevating the overall quality

• Help create a more polished, intuitive, and engaging player experience across all interactions and screens

• Collaborate closely with Art Direction and UI/UX to iterate quickly and continuously raise the quality bar

This is a unique opportunity to join a project early, have meaningful ownership, and directly influence the player experience and visual identity of a highly ambitious mobile game.

Requirements

We are looking for a Senior UI Artist with strong mobile gaming experience and excellent graphic design fundamentals , capable of creating polished, game-ready interfaces and implementing them directly inside Unity.

The ideal candidate combines strong visual polish, usability instincts, production autonomy, and collaborative communication skills. This is not a pure illustration role and not a pure UX design role. we are looking for someone who understands how to build clear, polished, and production-ready UI for mobile games.

You’re a great fit if you have:

• Strong UI and graphic design fundamentals, including readability, hierarchy, composition, color usage, interaction clarity, visual consistency, and information prioritization

• Experience creating clean, polished, and production-ready UI assets for mobile games with Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop.

• Hands-on experience integrating UI assets directly inside Unity, including working with scenes, prefabs, and implementation flows

• Experience working on mobile games and understanding the constraints and expectations of mobile-first UI design, including dense information layouts, readability, and player interaction flows

• A collaborative mindset and comfort working in highly iterative and feedback-heavy environments

• The ability to work autonomously, take initiative, contribute ideas, and collaborate pragmatically within a small team

• We are particularly interested in candidates who can balance strong visual execution with usability and production realities.

• Motion design experience

• UI animation experience and Unity animation workflows

• Experience animating buttons, transitions, or interactions

• Figma Proficiency

• Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.

• ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.

• 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

• AppFollow: AI-powered platform that helps digital product teams turn user feedback into insights, automate support workflows, and improve their app store presence.

• Role: Senior Product Designer (Core product + Growth).

• Scope: Design complex product, activation, and billing flows, evolve the design system, and help shape AI-first design workflows.

• You: Strong individual contributor with solid product thinking and proven experience designing complex web products with measurable business impact.

• Location: Fully remote, with Europe-friendly time zones preferred.

Who we are

AppFollow is an AI-powered reputation management platform that helps digital product teams turn user feedback into actionable insights, automate support workflows at any scale and improve their presence in app stores. Trusted by brands like Adobe, Rovio, Scopely, and Disney, AppFollow is built for teams of all sizes, from indie makers and growing businesses to global enterprises.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer who can work across both core product and growth. This is a strong individual contributor role for someone who can break down complex product challenges into solutions with clear business value and collaborate closely with product and engineering from discovery to release and iteration. You're great at designing complex workflows, improving funnels through experiments, and using research and product data to make informed decisions. We'd also value someone who consistently strengthens the design function by improving our design system, team practices, and cross-team collaboration.

This role is primarily open to candidates working within European time zones. We're a remote-first company, so you can work from anywhere, except countries under EU/US sanctions. We support focused work with async collaboration, and we also make time to meet in person through team off-sites, hackathons, and optional co-working.

What you'll work on

• Shaping and improving core product experiences (review management, Automation, and AI features that unlock new customer value).

• Improving activation, onboarding, and billing flows, helping customers understand the product faster, reach value earlier, and get from sign-up to paid with less friction.

• Driving our design system adoption, with broader component coverage, faster iteration and fewer custom one-offs in production.

• Building AI-based design workflows that reduce manual work, improve design/frontend consistency, bring PM-friendly realistic prototyping, and shorten the overall path from idea to production.

How you'll work

• Take ownership of the design for product initiatives across the Core and Growth teams, from problem framing to release and post-release iterations.

• Partner closely with PMs, EMs, Engineers, and QA to move fast, stay aligned, minimize handoff loss, and make sure design decisions survive implementation.

• Make handoff clear and async-friendly through Loom videos, Jira specs, Figma annotations, and prototypes for more complex flows.

• Evolve our design system by building and refining components, defining patterns, and making sure teams use them consistently.

• Growth team specifics: map funnels, identify drop-offs, propose improvements, support experiments that move specific conversion rates.

• Core team specifics: improve existing workflows, identify new opportunities, and validate what's worth building by using customer feedback, product analytics, session reviews, competitor research and business context.

Who we're looking for

• 5+ years in product design with a portfolio that shows both shipped work and your decision-making (B2B SaaS and complex web apps experience is preferred);

• Strong product thinking: your UX decisions are grounded in product strategy, address both user and business needs, and lead to measurable outcomes.

• Proven experience improving a workflow or funnel with measurable impact (activation, conversion, adoption, task success, time-to-value, etc.).

• Experience in designing data-heavy, workflow-driven interfaces (tables, filters, role-based experiences, multi-step flows, interconnected entities, and state-aware design).

• Hands-on experience with design systems (building and scaling components and patterns, driving component adoption and pattern consistency, partnering with frontend).

• Advanced Figma skills (variables, components, modes, prototyping, Figma Make). You keep your files clean and well-structured, and follow shared team conventions so other designers can quickly understand and continue your work.

• Strong collaboration skills with product and engineering (you can communicate your thoughts clearly, give and receive feedback and proactively drive alignment between teams).

• Upper-intermediate spoken and written English for day-to-day work.

Nice to have

• Experience working in design teams that use AI as a core part of their workflows.

• Experience designing products or workflows related to customer feedback management, support, analytics, or other operational B2B tools.

• Confidence working with product analytics, ability to independently explore funnels, investigate user behavior, and use product data to support design decisions.

• Advanced use of AI assistants for research and faster delivery (note: AI-generated designs are not currently accepted).

• You'll work in a team mature enough to ship consistently, but small enough for individual contribution to matter.

• Paid sick leave and extra days off for special occasions.

• Health coverage with options tailored to your location.

3 months. You have the lay of the land. Role overview

We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to join Kota’s Customer Platform team. Own the Core Product - Your work directly impacts how our customers use Kota. You will be responsible for turning complexity into clear, intuitive flows and interfaces.

•
Design Fast, Ship Right - Designing and writing is how we think together and drive product alignment. You have to move at pace but don’t lose quality as we start building and scaling.

•
Craft-Driven Culture - We believe innovation truly happens when we push beyond “good enough”. From microcopy to complex web interactions, you will work with people that sweat the details and ship with care.

Modern Design Environment - Work with cutting-edge technologies and tools to define the future of insurance UX.

•
Autonomy and Ownership - We hire outstanding people and get out of their way. You will have responsibility from day one, with space to do your best work.

What You’ll Do

•
Own key web product areas from early concepts to shipped implementation

•
Turn ambiguous product problems into clear flows, interfaces, and interaction models

•
Raise the quality bar through design quality, critique, and thoughtful collaboration

•
Use Cursor or Claude Code to prototype, build, and iterate through simple interfaces.

•
Identify and design reusable components and patterns that improve consistency and speed across our Platform product.

•
Partner closely with engineering to scope, design, iterate, and ship at high velocity

•
Contribute to product thinking, the overall direction of our product, and growing our design culture, not just shipping new features.

What We’re Looking For

•
Experience as a product designer working on complex products, ideally in B2B, fintech, or other information-dense environments.

•
End-to-end thinking and ownership, from big-picture systems thinking to the smallest interaction detail.

•
Balance of speed and detail, knowing when to move fast and when to obsess over the last 1%.

Proven experience creating, maintaining, and scaling design systems and thinking in ways to create reusable patterns and components across each product.

•
Agency, ownership, and autonomy; someone who doesn’t wait to be told what to do.

Comfort working with AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, even if you are not writing production-ready code.

A portfolio that shows strong product thinking, interaction design, and craft.

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 160 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

•
Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

•
Earned 145k+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

•
Been ranked as one of Europe’s most promising privately held SaaS startups (4th in Sifted’s 2025 B2B SaaS Rising 100)

•
Raised $240m to date, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our recent $180m Series C - bringing us to a $2.5bn valuation

•
And are grateful for our 94 eNPS score (most companies would call 70 excellent)

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

We’re looking for a seasoned Product Designer who thrives in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.

We’re currently hiring for different teams with specific focus on:

•
Enterprise: You’ve worked on technical B2B platforms where workflows are the product. You’ve designed for scale, governance and collaboration across teams including permissions, environments, observability and failure modes included and you’re comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.

•
AI: This team is perfect for designers who've worked on AI tools, agents, or builders and want to push the boundaries of AI-powered automation. You'll define the future of AI-powered workflows.

•
Growth : We're seeking a designer who thrives on rapid iteration and experimentation. You have experience optimizing onboarding and activation flows, you're motivated by moving metrics, and you excel at testing, learning, and iterating quickly.

•
Marketplace: This role is ideal for designers experienced with multi-sided platforms (like e-commerce or talent marketplaces) where you balance distinct needs of the supply and demand sides. You'll build something new from the ground up in a brand new team.

Our team structure evolves quickly and these team assignments may shift in the coming weeks.

🎯 Regardless of the team your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n’s user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

End-to-end product design

•
Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.

•
Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.

•
Work effectively on complex features with a strong engineering mindset and understanding of the underlying technology.

•
Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

•
Champion the user by running interviews, usability tests, and research to inform critical product and business decisions.

•
Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates’ work.

•
Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

•
Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product’s big picture.

•
Account for edge cases, constraints, and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.

•
Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.

Strategy, impact, and innovation

•
Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritization, and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.

•
Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

•
🎨 Product design excellence: You’re proficient across product design, UX, UI, and qualitative research, delivering polished, detail-oriented work.

•
🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies.

•
🧭 Ownership & delivery: You’ve shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.

•
⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.

•
📈 Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.

•
🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You’re open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team’s bar.

•
🧪 Curiosity for AI: You’re enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.

•
📅 Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.

Nice-to-haves

•
💻 Front-end fluency: You can prototype or collaborate using HTML/CSS/JavaScript frameworks.

•
🧩 AI & automation domain: You’ve designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.

•
🔁 Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.

•
📚 Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.

•
🔎 Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.

•
📊 Data-informed design: You’re comfortable with metrics, A/B testing, or SQL to guide decisions.

•
🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You’ve built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a slide deck. You’ll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces—shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise features, growth journeys, or a new marketplace—from discovery to delivery. You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, partnering closely with PMs and engineers to ship real outcomes to a passionate global community.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ).

•

Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

An ambitious but kind culture 😍 – People love working here—our eNPS for 2024 is 94!

Created by the world’s top scientists, ZOE is reimagining a fundamental human need: eating well for your body.

Our personalised nutrition program combines cutting‑edge science, technology, and behavioural insights to help people make better food choices for long‑term health. Today, ZOE supports 100k+ members across the UK and US, and our research has been published in leading journals including Nature Medicine , Science , and The Lancet . Our Science & Nutrition Podcast has reached millions worldwide.

We’re a remote‑first, mission‑driven company backed by founders and investors who’ve built multi‑billion‑dollar technology businesses. At ZOE, we value curiosity, care, ownership, transparency, and inclusivity . We move fast, learn in the open, and support each other while tackling complex, meaningful problems.

About the Role 🚀

We’re looking for our next Senior Product Designer to join our Ecommerce squad , a critical team with the mission “of making discovering, understanding, and purchasing of ZOE products effortless and joyful”.

This role is primarily focused on web surfaces across our marketing, discovery, and purchase journeys. You’ll work closely with Product Managers and Engineers as part of a cross‑functional squad, designing end‑to‑end ecommerce experiences that balance member needs, scientific integrity, and business outcomes.

As a Senior Product Designer at ZOE, you’ll own problems from early discovery through to high‑fidelity execution and implementation. You’ll help translate complex propositions into clear, intuitive, and delightful experiences — raising the bar for both UX and UI craft along the way.

About the Team ⚙️

You’ll be part of a product trio (Product Manager, Designer, Engineering Lead) within the Ecommerce squad, collaborating daily with engineers, data partners, and stakeholders across Growth, Brand, Content, and Science.

You’ll also join ZOE’s broader Experience team — a small muliti-disciplinary group of Product Designers, a Content Designer, a Motion Designer and UX Researchers. We care deeply about craft, clarity, and impact. We challenge each other, learn together, and believe that great work can and should be joyful.

What You’ll Do 🎯

•
Own ecommerce experiences end‑to‑end , from problem framing and discovery through to detailed UI and implementation

•
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape strategy, define success, and ship high‑quality outcomes

•
Design intuitive, conversion‑aware journeys across web‑based discovery and purchase flows

•
Make complex concepts and value propositions feel simple, human, and trustworthy

•
Use research, data, and experimentation to (in)validate design decisions and iterate with confidence

•
Bring strong UX and UI craft , with attention to interaction, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and polish

•
Present work clearly to stakeholders, incorporating feedback while advocating for the user

•
Contribute to and evolve our design system , improving consistency and speed without sacrificing quality

•
Help raise the bar for design quality, collaboration, and ways of working within the team

This role will be a great fit if you…💫

Experience & Craft

•
Have 5–8+ years designing digital products in product‑led teams (B2C experience strongly preferred)

•
Have shipped and iterated on web‑first or ecommerce experiences at scale

•
Are a strong UX thinker who can also deliver high‑quality UI and visual design

•
Have a portfolio that shows end‑to‑end ownership , clear problem‑solving, and measurable impact

Product Mindset

•
Think in systems and journeys, not just screens

•
Balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints thoughtfully

Measure success by real‑world outcomes , not what’s in the design file

•
Are comfortable working in ambiguity and shaping clarity with your team

•
Are a collaborative partner — pragmatic, kind, and enjoyable to work with

•
Communicate clearly and prefer simple, direct language over jargon

•
Are open to feedback and iterate quickly without losing craft quality

Take ownership, follow through, and care deeply about doing great work

Care about health, wellbeing, and improving people’s lives

•
Bring a member‑first mindset to decisions

•
Value inclusivity, accessibility, and ethical design

•
Enjoy learning, experimenting, and growing alongside others

Why join ZOE?

•
Work on meaningful problems with real impact on people’s health

•
Collaborate with world‑class scientists, designers, and technologists

•
Help shape a product and brand at a pivotal moment of growth

•
Enjoy a remote‑first environment built on trust, flexibility, and support

•
Be part of a team that takes its mission seriously — but not itself

Together, we’re building experiences that make better health feel possible, understandable, and joyful.

The experience, skills, and attributes we’ve outlined are what we believe will help someone truly thrive in this role.

However, we understand that talent comes in many forms. If you are genuinely excited about ZOE's mission and this opportunity, please don't hesitate to apply —even if you don't meet every single requirement listed.

We fundamentally value potential and commitment above all else. We are dedicated to fostering growth and providing opportunities for you to learn and develop alongside us.

We are looking for a Lead Product Designer to join our Design Team and contribute to the development of a large-scale audit and inspection platform used by global clients.

Lead Product Designer owns a product end-to-end and is responsible for its design outcomes from discovery through delivery. This is a product-ownership role, roughly 50% focused on designing key flows, systems, and experiences, and 50% on aligning with clients, product, and engineering, guiding/leading designers, and ensuring high-quality delivery.

This role is for a Product Design Leader who likes ownership, complexity, and impact. Someone who can think in systems, guide product direction, work closely with product and engineering, and turn complicated processes into something people can actually use in the field.

If you enjoy solving hard problems, designing for real constraints, and building a platform that directly affects how global businesses operate, this is that kind of product.

About the project:

Auditing Platform is a complex, real-world product used by large enterprise clients to run on-site audits, inspections, and quality evaluations across thousands of physical locations.

The product sits at the intersection of operations, compliance, analytics, and human workflows. It deals with messy, high-stakes reality: offline work, long inspections, strict rules, scoring logic, approvals, re-audits, reporting, and accountability. It’s not a “happy path” consumer app – it’s a system people rely on to do their job correctly, fast, and under pressure.

Case studies: https://www.trinetix.com/case-studies/driving-brand-operations-excellence-with-data-enabled-auditing

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in product or UX/UI design, preferably in enterprise or SaaS products

• Experience designing complex applications with data-heavy interfaces and workflow-driven logic

• Strong experience working directly with clients and stakeholders

• Good understanding of technical constraints, including backend logic, workflows, and system rules

• Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and Business System Analysts

• Experience contributing to or maintaining design systems

• Structured, self-organized approach to work

• Knowledge of accessibility principles

• Good level of spoken and written English (At least Upper-Intermediate, all of our clients speak English, and our designers often participate in conversations)

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience in audit, inspection, or compliance-related domains

• Previous experience mentoring or leading designers

• Background in enterprise web and mobile products

Core Responsibilities

• Lead client-facing design activities, including requirement clarification, design discussions, and solution alignment

• Collect, analyze, and synthesize business asks, user needs, and uncover technical constraints

• Design user-centered solutions for audit and inspection workflows, considering real user goals and operational constraints

• Own design delivery from discovery and concept to validation and development handoff

• Work closely with developers and BSA to ensure alignment with system logic, workflows, and technical constraints

• Support and maintain product design processes, including user research, hypothesis validation, and concept development

• Assign and review design tasks for designers within the team

• Contribute to the design system and ensure design consistency across products and platforms

• Clearly and professionally communicate design decisions to clients and internal stakeholders

What we offer

• Continuous learning and career growth opportunities

• Professional training and English/Spanish language classes

• Comprehensive medical insurance

• Mental health support

• Specialized benefits program with compensation for fitness activities, hobbies, pet care, and more

• Flexible working hours (you need to have at least 4 hours overlap with our US client's morning time)

• Inclusive and supportive culture

You will balance the visual polish of a high-performance marketing website with the robust architecture of a state-heavy web application.

Core Design Domains

• E-commerce & Conversion: Leading the strategy for high-conversion storefronts, complex product catalogs, and dynamic pricing engines.

• Design System & Motion: Maintain a modular component library and use purposeful, premium animations to make the platform feel intuitive and alive.

New features

Marketing alignment

At Miaplaza, we build homeschool platforms that kids aged 4–18 actually
want to use — Miacademy, MiaPrep, and our Online High School are serving
over 150.000 students today. Our product foundations are strong. What we
want next is a step change in how our products feel: more expressive
illustration, more purposeful motion, more moments of craft that turn a
lesson into something a kid remembers.

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer whose craft anchor is illustration
and motion. Our design team is small and senior, five designers when you
join, and each brings a distinct strength: brand, design systems, research,
and now yours.

The role

You'd own product design for the student learning experience end-to-end:
from problem framing through delivery, in a Product Trio with a PM and EM
who have strong opinions and expect yours. This is product work with real
trade-offs — pedagogical, technical, and business — and you're accountable
for how it lands, not just how it looks.

Beyond Curriculum, you'd set the illustration and motion bar for all of
Miaplaza: the standards, motion principles, and character direction that
the other designers and the design system build from.

A defining part of the role is art-directing AI-assisted production. You'd
build the prompts, references, and review process that let a small team
produce quality illustration and motion at a scale hand-crafting alone
can't reach. We don't expect you to know every current tool — we expect the
taste and judgment to direct output rather than accept defaults.

You'd report to the Head of UX, with regular 1:1s covering craft, product,
and career growth. The direction is upward: deeper craft leadership,
cross-product influence, or both.

Job requirements

You must have all of these to be considered:

• A portfolio of shipped digital product work — not only concepts or standalone pieces

• At least 2 years working inside a product team, collaborating with PMs and engineers

• Strong illustration or motion skills, with at least 1 year focused on either as a primary craft

• Proficiency in Figma

• Some experience directing or guiding visual work produced by others — freelancers, junior designers, or AI tools

You’ll stand out if you also have:

• Deep motion skills in product contexts: interactions, transitions, onboarding, character animation

• Experience using AI image or motion tools as production accelerators

• Confidence running your own usability research, not just receiving findings

• Multi-brand or education-focused design experience

• Accessibility practice, especially for neurodivergent audiences

This probably isn’t right for you if:

• Your work hasn't yet lived inside a live product with real constraints

• You prefer well-scoped tasks over shaping ambiguous problems

• You see AI tools as either a threat to craft or a shortcut around it

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding
the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is
longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time
and grateful you’re spending it with us.

• Application and eligibility check — work authorization, timezone, availability

•
Async assessment — 12 scenario-based, multiple-choice questions
(~30 min) + when qualifying; 3 open questions (max. 45 min)

• If you pass the multiple choice section, you will be asked to complete 3 open written questions (max. 45 min)

• Portfolio review — the design team will review your best work and thinking

• Behavioral interview — a conversation with our People team about how you work

• Take-home design task — ~60 minutes, scoped for this role, AI tools encouraged

• Hiring team interview — with a design team member and the Head of UX

• Skip-level conversation — with executive leadership

• Reference checks

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we
don't want to make yours harder.

POSTED 25d ago

WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In .

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.

TEAM INTEGRATION

•
Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

•
Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

•
Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

•
Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success

ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

•
Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

•
Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

•
Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

•
Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

•
Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft.

•
Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles.

•
Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work.

•
Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Product Design

•
Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind.

•
Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch.

•
Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly.

•
Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable.

•
Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement).

•
Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices.

UX Research & Strategy

•
Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis.

•
Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions.

•
Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on.

•
Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone.

•
Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs.

•
Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics.

•
Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go.

Web & Brand Experience

•
Own the design and evolution of WunderGraph's web presence.

•
Deliver assets that span product and marketing: landing pages, visuals, campaign graphics, and interactive components.

•
Shape and maintain a cohesive style guide, balancing design innovation with consistency.

•
Support brand storytelling with motion graphics and interactive elements.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

•
Senior-level experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work.

•
Proven experience planning and running UX research (both generative and evaluative) and turning findings into strategy.

•
Proficiency in Figma, prototyping tools, and Adobe Creative Suite.

•
Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability.

•
Experience contributing to or leading design systems and component libraries.

•
Comfortable using data and research to inform and defend design decisions.

•
Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript a plus) enough to collaborate closely with engineers.

•
Excellent communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills in English.

•
A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead initiatives independently in a fast-moving startup.

•
Comfortable working 100% remotely in a distributed team.

•
Willingness to travel occasionally for team retreats and workshops.

Why WunderGraph?

•
Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

•
Pick your preferred work hardware

•
We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

•
You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

•
Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

•
Competitive compensation

•
Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

•
Team retreats across the globe

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

•
30 min intro call with Mariya from our People team

•
45 min discussion with the hiring manager. Following this, you might receive a small take home assignment related to the role. This is your chance to prove your skill!

•
Complete the assignment and review together with hiring manager

•
Meet the founders

•
Culture fit call with team members

•
Offer

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

We’re looking forward to your application so we can grow together!

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. About You

You're a product designer who owns problems, not screens. You're comfortable with ambiguity, can partner with PMs to shape direction, and know how to translate research insights into production-ready interfaces, working closely with engineers. You ship work that matters.

The Team

Our AI Agent Tools team is building a new category of e-commerce experience: intelligent agents that guide shoppers, learn from merchandiser expertise, and drive real business outcomes. This is one of the most consequential design problems in retail right now, and it's wide open.

Requirements

The Role

You'll be designing the future of product discovery: the moment a shopper goes from intent to purchase, reimagined through AI.

•
You'll define what agentic shopping looks like — Not just chatbots bolted onto search, but genuinely new interaction patterns where AI understands what a shopper wants and helps them get there. There's no established playbook here. The patterns you set will shape how the rest of the industry approaches it.

•
You'll shape how merchandisers control it — You will collaborate with Agent Orchestrators—professionals blending data analysis, design, and shopper psychology—to design the dashboard tools that allow them to configure, train, and optimize new shopping journeys without engineering support.

•
You'll prove it works in the real world — From running UI experiments on live retailer sites to validating new shopping experiences with actual shopper data, your designs ship and get measured.

What You'll Own

•
Research & validation — Conducting shopper research and running experiments alongside product and data teams to validate hypotheses with real input.

•
Interaction design for agentic experiences — Mapping novel user flows where AI/LLMs drive the shopping journey, for both shoppers and the merchandisers who orchestrate them.

•
Visual strategy — Defining a bold design direction that represents what product discovery looks like in 2027.

•
High-fidelity delivery — Producing final mockups and assets across key surfaces: homepage, search, PDP, filtering, guided shopping, and agent configuration.

•
UX patterns — Ensuring designs scale within Constructor's evolving design system and component library.

What We Value Beyond Craft

Beyond being a thoughtful designer, user advocate, and strong collaborator, here are a few things we really value:

•
A goal-oriented, iterative mindset — You focus on solving high-impact problems and are comfortable learning, improving, and shipping quickly.

•
Practical experience with research — You’ve led user interviews, usability tests, and data analysis.

•
Experience designing for unfamiliar problems — You’ve worked on products where you had to understand complex workflows outside your own experience—especially in B2B contexts.

•
Systems thinking — You spot patterns, define systems, and design scalable, reusable solutions.

🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live.

💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees.

•
🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year.

•
👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees.

•
📈 Stock options - offered in addition to the base salary

At Remote you you will work with a thriving cross-discipline team of designers, developers and PMs and with a talented, close-knit team of product designers who will inspire you and support your growth. Design at Remote

Canonical is the company behind Ubuntu, the leading operating system for container, cloud, internet of things and hyperscale computing, central to modern tech from development to production.


Our design team, centred in Europe, has specialists in visual and UX design, and front and back end development. We collaborate, as product design squads, with global distributed development engineering teams.

Read more about the design team


About you


Senior UX designers should be strong communicators who are as much at ease talking to and working with senior executives as they are their own teammates. They can represent their team or the Design department at cross-functional company meetings and will be able to voice/present the Design position with clarity and precision. You are passionate about taking on complex design challenges meeting user needs and you enjoy working with the design team and teams across Canonical to deliver on the strategic vision for the company.


You will be working closely with other user experience and visual designers, front and back-end developers, and project management, as part of the design team, reporting to the Head of UX under the Design Director.


What you will be doing


You will be part of a team working on web applications for enterprise cloud services, IoT and embedded devices, bringing exciting new projects to life and improving existing ones.



• You will be leading your product-specific projects, driving design and delivery against agreed goals and working with designers, product management and engineering to deliver on the strategic vision for Canonical.


• You will plan and conduct research with target users and stakeholders from the business to identify and document users' needs and requirements as well as business requirements and KPIs


• You will manage incoming requests for work that affects you and needs to be considered (e.g. project briefs) and balance and prioritise the various projects’ requirements. In your day to day you are defining the scope, milestones and deliverables for any given iteration.


• You apply agile/lean project management methodologies. You will be the person resolving any blockers on your projects, through clear communication with project management and actively seeking help from team members, your manager and others.


• You will liaise with relevant stakeholders and engineers to achieve company goals, making time to talk via messaging applications, setting up and attending regular meetings, reviewing work with them in advance, sharing progress and seeking their input to achieve consensus and drive progress.


• We try as much as we can to share our experiences and knowledge within the team and to the community through informal presentations, the design blog and other events.


• Driving the adoption of Vanilla, our front end framework. You will be encouraging teammates to use or iterate existing patterns or when desired to design new patterns that are used across Canonical products and available as an open source resource.




Required Skills And Experience




• Ability to maintain a good view across a number of projects, and to be a go-to person for the design team as a whole and work with other seniors and leads to align overall departmental processes


• Ability to articulate clearly and effectively your design decisions to team members, engineers and stakeholders


• Ability to develop the process / approach for tackling a design problem and to lead the exploration and design solutions of undefined problem spaces


• Ability to set up, attend and run weekly catch-ups with engineers and stakeholders you are collaborating with


• Desire to work collaboratively with team members across different disciplines


• Ability to work in an agile way and manage your own workload to deliver designs to agreed timescales


• Motivation to drive understanding of impact and success metrics to focus your efforts. Develop a good working knowledge of KPI’s and Google Analytics - goal setting and tracking, A/B testing etc.


• Proficiency in design and prototyping tools and basic understanding of HTML and CSS


• Bachelor’s or master’s degrees or equivalent


• 5~7 years experience in UX design roles




What we offer



• Opportunity to help shape a company and products with strong influence in the open source community


• A fantastic work environment within a team of friendly people with a broad range of skill sets, from UX and visual designers to researchers and engineers


• Opportunity to create work that will potentially be seen by millions of people


• Remote role (EMEA time zone required) with good travel opportunities, predominantly to the US and Europe. Great benefits on offer too.


• Benefits package, including cycle to work scheme, pension scheme and health insurance

Responsibilities

AI Experience Design

• Rapidly prototype and compare UX solutions before committing significant production time.

• Own information architecture, navigation, screen hierarchy, interaction patterns, usability, and player comprehension.

• Design intuitive experiences for gameplay, progression, onboarding, rewards, LiveOps, social features, and monetization.

• Proactively identify UX problems through design reviews, prototypes, and playable builds.

• Follow features through implementation and work with Engineering to preserve design intent.

• Improve the Game Design → UX → Art → Engineering workflow so features move through production with clearer intent and fewer late-stage redesigns.

• Establish reusable UX patterns, UI components, interaction standards, and documentation.

• Mentor and work in parallel with another UI/UX Designer while remaining directly involved in execution.

• Partner closely with the Art Director to define and evolve the visual language of the UI, translating the game’s overall art direction into a cohesive, scalable interface system.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

• Senior or Lead-level experience designing UI/UX for shipped games.

• Strong shipped experience with mobile Free-to-Play games , ideally casual or mass-market titles.

• A portfolio demonstrating both UX thinking and finished game experiences , not just polished UI screens.

• Strong ability to turn complex game systems into simple, intuitive player experiences.

• Excellent understanding of mobile interaction design, information architecture, hierarchy, readability, feedback, and usability.

• Experience designing F2P systems such as progression, rewards, FTUE, events, LiveOps, and monetization.

• Strong wireframing and interactive prototyping skills.

• Strong proficiency with Figma or equivalent modern product-design tools.

• Strong UI design fundamentals and the ability to take work beyond low-fidelity UX when needed.

• Strong product judgment and a proactive approach to identifying and solving experience problems.

• Experience mentoring or providing design direction to other UI/UX Designers.

• Experience collaborating closely with Game Designers, Artists, Engineers, Product Managers, and Producers throughout feature development.

• Familiarity with Unity-based game production is highly valuable.

• Comfort using AI-assisted or rapid-prototyping tools to explore and validate design solutions faster is a plus.

Portfolio

A strong portfolio is essential for this role.

We are particularly interested in examples that demonstrate:

• Shipped mobile and F2P game experiences

• User flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes

• Evolution from early UX concepts to final shipped UI

• Gameplay, onboarding, progression, rewards, LiveOps, or monetization UX

• Examples where you simplified a complex feature or solved a meaningful usability problem

• Your individual contribution versus the work of the broader team

• Have significant influence over the product while it is still actively being shaped.

• Establish the UX processes, standards, and design systems that guide the project.

• Experiment with rapid prototyping and AI-assisted workflows to increase iteration speed and design quality.

• 100% remote, flexible work with a small, experienced team.

• Paid Time Off

• Performance Bonus

• Annual Performance Reviews

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI to help define the next generation of intelligent experiences across Intermedia's products.

In this role, you will design experiences that make artificial intelligence useful, intuitive, trustworthy, and approachable for business users. You will work at the intersection of UX strategy, interaction design, generative AI, conversational experiences, and enterprise software , turning sophisticated AI capabilities into simple experiences that solve real customer problems.

You will partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML teams, Engineering, Research, and other designers throughout the complete product lifecycle—from customer and market research through concepts, prototyping, development, launch, and post-launch analysis.

This is not simply a role for adding AI features to existing interfaces. You will help define how users interact with AI across our products , including copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendations, summarization, intelligent automation, and agentic experiences.

Key Responsibilities
AI Experience Design

• Design intuitive user experiences for AI-powered capabilities across web, desktop, mobile, and administrative interfaces.

• Explore new interaction models for generative AI, including conversational interfaces, copilots, AI assistants, intelligent recommendations, content generation, summarization, and AI-driven workflow automation.

• Design experiences for emerging agentic AI capabilities where AI systems can reason, recommend actions, execute tasks, and coordinate multi-step workflows on behalf of users.

• Translate complex AI functionality into simple, understandable interactions appropriate for everyday business users.

• Determine when AI should proactively assist users versus when users should explicitly initiate or control AI functionality.

• Design effective patterns for prompts, suggestions, generated content, AI actions, confirmations, feedback, and human intervention.

• Create experiences that communicate what an AI system is doing, why it made a recommendation, and what actions it has taken or intends to take.

UX & Product Design

• Own design initiatives from discovery and concept development through prototyping, implementation, launch, and post-launch optimization.

• Conduct user research, usability studies, interviews, competitive analysis, and workflow analysis to understand customer needs and behaviors.

• Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.

• Develop and validate design hypotheses through rapid prototyping and user testing.

• Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows through thoughtful UX and intelligent automation.

• Use qualitative and quantitative data to evaluate experiences and recommend improvements.

• Work closely with Product Management to ensure designs address meaningful customer problems and measurable business outcomes.

AI Trust & Responsible Design

• Design AI experiences that establish appropriate levels of trust, transparency, and user control .

• Clearly distinguish AI-generated information and actions where appropriate.

• Design graceful experiences for uncertainty, incomplete information, errors, hallucinations, and situations where the AI cannot confidently complete a request.

• Create effective confirmation, undo, escalation, and human-in-the-loop patterns for AI-driven actions.

• Design feedback mechanisms that allow users to evaluate, correct, or improve AI-generated results.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Legal teams to incorporate responsible AI principles into the user experience.

• Help establish UX guidelines for consistent and responsible use of AI throughout Intermedia products.

Design Systems

• Contribute to and evolve Intermedia's design system to support AI-powered experiences.

• Define reusable patterns and components for conversational interfaces, AI recommendations, generated content, AI actions, status indicators, feedback mechanisms, and agentic workflows.

• Ensure new AI capabilities integrate naturally with established product experiences rather than feeling like disconnected features.

• Maintain consistency across products while identifying where emerging AI interactions require new design paradigms.

• Partner with designers and developers to ensure design-system components are practical, scalable, accessible, and consistently implemented.

Collaboration & Leadership

• Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, researchers, and other designers.

• Facilitate design workshops and collaborative discovery sessions to explore customer problems and AI opportunities.

• Clearly communicate design rationale, research findings, user needs, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Challenge assumptions and advocate for customer-centered solutions when technology or implementation considerations begin driving the experience.

• Provide design leadership and mentorship to other designers and help raise the overall quality of UX across the organization.

• Collaborate effectively across multiple teams and product areas to create coherent end-to-end customer experiences.

• Stay current with emerging AI technologies, interaction patterns, and design practices and translate relevant developments into practical product experiences.

Our Expectations

• 5+ years of professional UI/UX, Product Design, or Interaction Design experience, ideally designing complex SaaS or enterprise software.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, complex workflows, interaction design, and thoughtful problem solving.

• Excellent knowledge of usability, UX/UI, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and human factors principles.

• Strong ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into simple, elegant solutions.

• Experience conducting or participating in user research and usability testing.

• Strong proficiency with Figma , prototyping tools, and modern design-system practices.

• Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering in an Agile software-development environment.

• Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to work effectively with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.

• Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the broader product and customer experience.

AI Experience & Knowledge

We don't expect you to be an AI engineer, but we do expect curiosity and practical fluency with modern AI technologies.

The ideal candidate has:

• Experience designing products or features powered by generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation.

• Understanding of large language models (LLMs) and the opportunities and limitations they introduce into product experiences.

• Familiarity with conversational UX and natural-language interfaces.

• Understanding of concepts such as prompts, context, AI-generated content, confidence and uncertainty, hallucinations, and AI feedback loops.

• Familiarity with AI agents and emerging patterns for designing systems that can perform multi-step actions on behalf of users.

• Experience thinking through trust, transparency, explainability, privacy, and user control in AI experiences.

• A strong interest in experimenting with new AI tools and interaction models.

Advantages

• Experience designing enterprise communications, collaboration, contact center, productivity, or workflow-automation products.

• Experience designing AI copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, or agentic workflows.

• Experience developing or contributing to large-scale design systems.

• Experience with voice and multimodal interfaces.

• Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design.

• Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of modern web applications.

• Experience using AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

• Experience working with globally distributed Product and Engineering teams.

What Success Looks Like

As a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI, you will help ensure that AI at Intermedia is not simply powerful technology—it is a valuable and trusted customer experience .

Success means:

• Customers immediately understand how AI can help them.

• Complex AI capabilities feel simple and natural to use.

• Users remain informed and in control when AI recommends or takes actions.

• AI features integrate seamlessly into existing customer workflows.

• Common AI interaction patterns become consistent across Intermedia products.

• Research and customer feedback meaningfully influence AI product decisions.

• Product and Engineering teams view Design as a strategic partner in determining what AI experiences should be built , not simply how they should look.

Ultimately, you will help establish the design language and interaction principles that shape how customers experience AI across Intermedia's portfolio.

P Pixie is hiring Product Designer

TYPE Full Time CATEGORY Product Design LOCATION Lisbon Portugal
This job post is over 2 months old and may no longer be available.

Description

Pixie’s growing product team is looking for a skilled product designer to join our Lisbon-based team. Applications for this role are open until 16 June.

Our new platform that just launched, the product backlog brimming with bright ideas, and fast growth make this an excellent opportunity for anyone looking to make their mark.

About the role

This is the perfect role for a design generalist who wants to do more than just UI and UX. You’ll be paired with a full-stack engineer to work on features in 6-week cycles (we’re adopting the Shape Up process more formally) and contribute with ideas, visual designs, and your own HTML and CSS (we use Tailwind).

You’ll be able to work on all aspects of the product and will not be boxed into working on optimising just a single feature.

You’ll be able to make decisions, talk with customers to clarify requirements and try out your ideas, and have a real influence on our growing team as we become more design-led.

About Pixie

We are on a 10-year journey to bring joy to 100,000 small accounting firms around the world with simple software, a great user experience, excellent customer service, and fair pricing.

Our platform streamlines and automates their workflows, ensuring they keep delighting their clients. We’re off to a great start with 3,500+ accountants and bookkeepers already loving our platform and relying on it daily to get work done.

As we continue to grow and make a positive impact, we’re seeking talented individuals who are passionate about their craft to help us build a team with an exceptional customer focus.

Requirements

These traits will make you a great fit for the role:

• 4+ years of experience in designing the UI and UX for B2B software products that target small businesses

• Exceptional attention to detail

• Above average fluency in HTML and CSS, either learnt from experience or through a coding Bootcamp

• Ability to write clear and grammatically correct product micro-copy in English

• Willingness to engage with customers, learn about their jobs to be done and incorporate those learnings into Pixie’s UX

• Ability to execute projects autonomously and in close collaboration with customers and teammates

• Bachelor/Master’s degree in a design-related discipline

Benefits

• Base salary of €38k-€45k plus equity

• Company budget for Apple laptop and accessories

• A collaborative environment where you’ll learn about and influence every aspect of the business

• Private health insurance and meal allowance

• 30 days of holidays, plus national holidays and birthdays off

• Discretionary growth budget for learning (eg. books, courses), gym, etc.

• Plenty of room and support to continue growing professionally

• Access to industry thought-leaders via our investors' platforms and networks

Applying for this role and our process

Please submit your application that includes a great written statement in English about why you love product design (we’ll use ChatGPT detection to disqualify applications). Applications will be open until 16 June, feel free to take your time and make a great impression!

We'd love you to submit a 4-5 minute Loom video walkthrough of a user journey in a live product that you designed, and learn what your thought process was, etc. If that isn't possible, send us a link to that product so that we can sign up.

As a last resort, you can submit a static portfolio, but we'll prioritise candidates that share a real product with us.

As mentioned above, we’re accepting applications until 16 June 2023. In the week following, we’ll review applications and invite candidates in for an interview. You’ll hear from us no later than 23 June.

Our interview schedule can take up to 2 hours: you’ll have the chance to meet your future teammates across multiple teams in the company, and dive into your experience, how you think about design and answer any questions you have for us.

We may ask the final candidates to do a paid take-home design challenge that reflects a typical scenario and lets us understand how you approach problems.

We’re aiming to make an offer by the beginning of July and hopefully welcome you to the team within a few weeks.

The frontend team consists of both our frontend developers and designers, we work closely with all parts of the business to create tools that vary across the whole company, from the publishing team to create a portal for people to submit games, the marketing team on things like our website, all the way to our internal teams for things like administration and analytics.

What Does The Job Actually Involve?

•
Creating responsive designs for both our internal and external tools/platforms as well as our website

Design new pages, update existing ones and add content where needed

Utilize new plugins and features to enhance the user experience

2+ years of experience as a web UI / UX Designer

Good knowledge of HTML / CSS

Mobile-first responsive design

Experience with Figma, Adobe XD or similar

Good communication skills

Attention to detail

Description

Trouva is one of the fastest growing tech businesses in Europe ( TNW Tech5 ), one of Wired Magazine's hottest European Startups and is 1st in the prestigious Startups 100 Index , ranking the UK’s best high growth startups.

A software-enabled marketplace, Trouva brings customers beautiful homewares from the best independent boutiques around the world. We’re building a different kind of e-commerce experience, driven by discovery and inspiration. Using cutting edge technology, Trouva harnesses the expertise of the best bricks-and-mortar shops from Shoreditch to Stockholm, and scales their offering online to connect with a global customer base seeking unique, hard-to-find homewares.

Backed by world-leading investors, we’re growing incredibly quickly and are looking for exceptional people to join the Trouva family. Get a feel for what we're about through our Instagram or vision page !

THE OPPORTUNITY

Trouva is hiring a Senior Product Designer to work across both our consumer and back-office products that make the world’s best boutique’s goods available online through our website and our new iOS app. The role is based out of our Lisbon office though we’re open to partially remote; we think it’s important for the team to be able to come together once or twice a week.

Product designers at Trouva are fascinated by the entire design process - from research to user interface design. Whilst each person tends to have more in-depth expertise in some areas than others, what we all share is a desire to become excellent all-round designers. Most of your time will be spent working with the product manager and software engineers in your cross-functional squad.

A typical week might look like:

• Work with PMs to articulate the most pressing outcomes we need to deliver

• Plan generative or evaluative research, help moderate the sessions and analyse the results

• Facilitate an ideation workshop to harness the whole team’s creativity. Then bring it all together into a coherent solution that can be prototyped and evaluated quickly

• Create beautiful UI utilising our existing web design system where appropriate

• Take part in our regular design team critique sessions where we support each other to our best work

• Present your work to stakeholders in the wider company

• Communicate your designs to devs and then work with them to design practical solutions to implement

Requirements

Before we tell you about what we’re looking for, this is a senior position so we do expect you to have good experience doing much of what follows. However, just to be clear, we don’t expect you to tick all of these boxes. If you’re a talented designer who can knock this job out the park, then show us your portfolio! We’re especially keen to hear from people with diverse backgrounds.

• You’ll be obsessed with typography, imagery, layout, and colour and how they can be used to tell a compelling story to our users

• You can eloquently and persuasively articulate why you designed something the way you did and are equally comfortable explaining that rationale to senior management as you are to other designers and engineers

• You’re intelligent, passionate about design, and endlessly curious. Your craving to learn new things is only outweighed by your urge to share your knowledge with others. You’re naturally observant and that awareness means you’re forever spotting ways to improve the world around you

• You see yourself as a maker. You move quickly and are creative of course but you also have a healthy dose of pragmatism that compels you towards getting things shipped and in front of users.

• You work well with engineers and can understand the limitations of digital products, whilst still pushing at those boundaries

• Being a great designer at Trouva is about driving people towards your vision of a better shopping experience. Your optimism will help you realize that vision

• You are keen to connect with our users (both shoppers and boutique owners) to understand the motivations behind their behaviours and so create experiences that move beyond mere problem solving and engage them on an emotional level

• You’re friendly, humble and approachable but also have the courage and principles to back your designs whilst taking onboard contrary evidence. In short, you have strong opinions, weakly held

• This role reports into the VP Design. The design team works across product, brand and marketing to create coherent, delightful experiences

• Skills in motion design would be a lovely bonus too

Perks

• Competitive salary

• 25 days holiday + bank holidays, plus a 'recoup and revive' day to use every 6 months

• Quarterly Wellness perks

• Competitive family and compassionate leave policies

• Flexible remote working policy

• Regular team events where we celebrate our success and people

• Need tech or equipment? We'll provide you with everything you need to get the job done

• Unlimited staff discount on all Trouva products and a Trouva gift card to get something awesome for your desk.

Estamos à procura de um(a) profissional dinâmico(a), autónomo(a) e com uma forte paixão por desenhar o futuro dos produtos digitais para integrar a nossa equipa de inovação core. O foco principal desta função será desenhar, testar e implementar interfaces e fluxos para plataformas SaaS e Mobile, garantindo uma visão estratégica alinhada com o negócio e focada na experiência do cliente.

Fazer a ponte com as equipas de desenvolvimento, assegurando que a visão de design é transmitida com clareza e implementada com fidelidade técnica.
Desenhar experiências de produto inovadoras potenciadas por IA, criando fluxos intuitivos para interações com assistentes virtuais, sistemas multi-agente ou automações complexas.
Integrar ferramentas de IA no teu próprio workflow de design para acelerar a ideação, prototipagem e validação de novos conceitos.
Explorar, testar e propor continuamente novas ideias, abordagens de UI/UX e frameworks emergentes de design para manter o produto no estado da arte.

Requisitos

Perfil e Competências Técnicas:

Experiência sólida em Product Design, UI/UX, com um portfólio robusto que demonstre soluções para sistemas SaaS.
Experiência comprovada no desenho de aplicações e experiências Mobile (iOS e Android).
Portfólio com projetos ou conceitos relacionados com IA (ex: desenho de dashboards inteligentes, fluxos assistidos por IA, interfaces conversacionais ou genAI).
Domínio total das ferramentas de design atuais (Figma, tokens de design).
Familiaridade com o ecossistema e lógicas de desenvolvimento (compreensão de como o código afeta o design).

Soft Skills & Perfil:

Curiosidade por IA e tecnologias emergentes: vontade constante de aprender e aplicar novas ferramentas ao processo criativo.
Mentalidade analítica e orientada ao cliente: capacidade de traduzir feedback e dados de utilização em melhorias reais de interface.
Forte sentido de autonomia, proatividade e excelente capacidade de comunicação para defender decisões de design perante stakeholders e desenvolvimento.

O que oferecemos

Participação direta na definição da estratégia, UX e identidade visual de plataformas de alto impacto.
Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, ágil e focado em soluções tecnológicas modernas, onde a experimentação e as novas ideias são incentivadas.
Integração em projetos core da empresa, com forte visibilidade e impacto direto no negócio e na vida dos utilizadores.

- Proativos e dinâmicos;
- Sentido de responsabilidade;

- Disponibilidade imediata

- 100% presencial
